notes: Triage of the story queue (fuse.mjs list, top 120 open and all leak-site claims). Closed 72 stories: 65 claims against small private organisations, and 7 non-events. Left open every story with a government or CERT source (CSIRT Italy Danfoss and Mitel, Swedish CERT-SE phishing warning, Citrix security update, Hong Kong HKCERT incidents) and every multi-publisher news story (the Hydro-Quebec, Equinor, IIHF, Japanese Osaki, US tech outage and Java4Shell clusters). Claims kept for public-importance organisations: Terminais (MZ), Osaki, Sonoco, Veritiv, Jeld-wen, Drive Medical, FAIR Health, AARP, Greater Elgin Family Care Center, Clinton Assessors Board, Mnfhs, primecareofmi (kept as uncertain), and the Helix and Whitearmor items for Sonoco, Veritiv and Jeld-wen. No open story was older than 12 hours with three or more publishers or a government source, so no priority-1 leads were recorded. No pages were opened; every decision was made from story titles and source lists.
